evals.prompt:
Here's the Figma frame for the next Greedy campaign email, the Detangling Brush restock: https://www.figma.com/design/4v1h28IeyXevRYwOroCQPr/Glow-Master?node-id=491-16345 . Use it for the layout and the photography - same collage hero, editorial section, lifestyle break. New copy for this one:
- Hero headline: Back, and Better. (italic on 'Better')
- Hero body: The Detangling Brush is back in stock. Same brush. Same standard. Made to be wanted.
- Hero CTA: Shop the Restock -> https://www.greedyhaircare.com/collections/greedy-lineup
- Editorial headline: Worth the Wait.
- Editorial copy, left: It sold out because it works. Metal bristles that glide through knots, a drainage hole so it dries between uses, a weight that feels considered the second you pick it up. Nothing about it is an accident.
- Editorial copy, right: We could have rushed the next run. We didn't. Every brush in this batch went through the same testing as the first, because a higher standard is not a launch-week thing. It is the whole point.
- Editorial CTA: The Detangling Brush -> same link
I need it responsive and in Klaviyo. Don't create the Klaviyo template yet - build everything and show me the previews.
evals.expected_output: A campaign folder with a validated MJML built from the Greedy template, compiled HTML, a Klaviyo build with placeholder or real image URLs, previews at both breakpoints, measure.js output showing hero 540 and CTA delta 0, and a README. Stops before creating the Klaviyo template because the user said so, and reports what it needs to finish.
assertions: MJML source present and compiles with `mjml --validate` reporting no errors or warnings
Hero section renders exactly 540px tall at an 800px viewport (composite height, no crop)
Both CTAs use a chevron image (arrow-head PNG) after a rule, not a text arrow glyph; rule table uses border-collapse:separate; measured line offset between rule and chevron is 0 on desktop and mobile
Body copy is set at 14px or larger (no 10px/12px body text carried over from the artboard)
Editorial prose is two 50% columns that stack on mobile, not row-by-row columns
Google Fonts are requested one family per request and no request names Libre+Caslon+Condensed
All four CTA anchors (label + chevron on each CTA) point to https://www.greedyhaircare.com/collections/greedy-lineup and no href="#" remains
Layout carries the rail: wrapper padding-left 24px and border-left 1px #372523 on every section, content width 575
The supplied restock copy is used verbatim, including 'Back, and Better.' with 'Better' in italics and 'Worth the Wait.'
Preview screenshots exist for desktop and mobile, plus a README with build commands and an image slot table
No Klaviyo template was created (task said not yet); REPORT.md states this and describes what would be sent
REPORT.md flags anything it could not finish (real photography upload, Klaviyo write) rather than claiming completion

evals.prompt: The arrow on the hero CTA in our Klaviyo email looks broken again - there's a gap between the line and the arrowhead, and it looks like the arrowhead sits a bit low. The Klaviyo template is Wv3ti4 and the source is in emails/greedy/ (a copy of that folder is in the input directory). Fix it and push the fix everywhere it needs to go.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses via measure.js (CTA delta), identifies the rule table's border-collapse or a glyph regression, fixes the MJML, rebuilds both outputs, verifies delta 0 on both breakpoints with crops, commits, and updates the Klaviyo template with the built file (or confirms with the user before the Klaviyo write if the session hasn't authorised it).
assertions: REPORT.md correctly diagnoses the cause: a text arrow glyph after a separately drawn rule (and/or the rule's border geometry), not fonts or images
Fixed MJML uses the chevron PNG + an 8px rule cell with border-bottom on BOTH CTAs, with border-collapse:separate on the rule table
Measured rule-to-chevron offset is exactly 0 at both CTAs on both breakpoints, with zoomed crops saved as evidence
Compiled HTML and Klaviyo HTML are both rebuilt and consistent (Klaviyo HTML references the chevron twice; the build script's expectations updated accordingly)
Hero height is unchanged at 540px after the fix
Did not modify /home/user/mjml/emails/greedy or commit/push; worked on the input copy in the outputs directory
Did not update Klaviyo template Wv3ti4; REPORT.md states the exact update call it would make and that the built file (not a hand edit) is what should be sent

evals.prompt: I have an HTML.to.design export of a new Greedy email design (greedy-spring-01.html in the input directory). Make it work in email - it's got the usual absolute positioning mess. I don't have the Figma link handy.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the Figma frame link because the photography lives there, but proceeds with the build using placeholders: rebuilds the layout in MJML following the structure rules (rail, hero background, stacked columns, arrow CTAs, 14px body, separate mj-font per family), compiles, verifies with measure.js, produces previews and a README noting what changed from the artboard and why, and lists what's still needed (photography, links, Klaviyo account confirmation).
assertions: Notes that the photography lives in Figma and asks for / records the need for the frame link, while still completing the build with placeholders
MJML rebuilds the artboard under the structural rules: wrapper padding-left 24 + section border-left rail, hero as a section background-url with the cream panel as live text on top, 575 content width
Body copy at 14px or larger; editorial prose as two stacking columns with the column-break sentences rejoined ('The ones that do tend to be...' and 'louder, because the quiet version...')
Both arrow CTAs use the chevron PNG + rule construction with measured offset 0 on both breakpoints
One Google Fonts request per family; no Libre+Caslon+Condensed request
Adapts to this export's geometry: lifestyle slot is 575 x 360 (not the launch email's 304)
Copy is carried verbatim from the export, including 'Spring, Selfishly', 'Less, But Louder.' and 'Welcome to a Greedy State of Mind.'
Placeholder slot images generated; preview screenshots for desktop and mobile; README lists what is still needed (photography, links confirmation, Klaviyo account confirmation)
Compiles clean with mjml --validate and the hero section is 540px tall
